notes:
Price watch: sizes, sorting & fixes
Price watch: stores that sell several sizes on ONE link (10 mg, 50 mg...) now work. In ⚠ Wrong price? → pick, press "Choose a size / option first", click your size on the page, press "Done choosing", then click the price. The app repeats your size click before every check. If the store changes its page and the size can no longer be found, the store shows under needs attention instead of saving the wrong price.
Price watch: stores inside each product are listed cheapest first (sold-out and unpriced last).
Price watch: fixed "a window is already open" showing when no window was open. It could block every sign-in button until the app was restarted.
Price watch: bulk add checks several links at a time, so a batch from different stores finishes 3 to 4 times faster.
Price watch: a Cloudflare "are you human?" page is now named clearly, with the steps to get past it.
